scope: Choose the narrowest claim entailed by a supplied synthetic source excerpt. This fixture demonstrates evidence discipline, not an empirical finding.
prediction_prompt: Before seeing the candidate claims, state what this source excerpt can and cannot establish.
expected_source_inputs: A public scene objective that asks for an evidence-grounded judgment
A source title, locator and exact excerpt available to the learner
Candidate claims whose support can be checked directly against the excerpt

independent_checks.description: The exact supplied excerpt and locator remain visible during judgment.
Only claim_supported restates the observed comparison without adding causality or generality.
The feedback names the inference that the source cannot support.

source.title: Synthetic controlled-growth note
source.statement: In this teaching dataset, culture A reached an optical density of 0.80 and culture B reached 0.60 after 12 hours under the stated conditions. No intervention was randomized.

claims.text: In the supplied dataset and conditions, culture A had the higher 12-hour optical density.
The culture label caused a 0.20 increase in optical density.
Culture A always grows faster than culture B.

feedback: The source supports the bounded comparison only. It does not establish causality or a result beyond the stated synthetic conditions.
